name: -10AN to -12AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler
title: -10AN to -12AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler
description:
The -10AN to -12AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler Fittings are precision-engineered to connect two female AN lines inline, featuring a 360° swivel design for effortless installation and flexible routing in tight spaces, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
